newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia Suburban buys water utility.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia Suburban buys water utility.

text.p: Philadelphia Suburban Water Co said Monday it completed the acquisition of Utility Group Services, owner of four Chester County companies -- the Spring Run, Friendship and Bradford Glen Water companies, and the Little Washington Drainage Co, a wastewater system.

The $7 million transaction is composed of the assumption of $2 million of UGS debt with 70 percent preferred stock and 30 percent cash being used to pay the balance, the Philadelphia Suburban Corp subsidiary said.

The merger adds to its water customer base some 8,500 residents from a 49-square-mile service area which encompasses West Bradford, East and West Brandywine and Newlin Townships. About 900 of the East Brandywine residents are also served by the wastewater system, the first Philadelphia Suburban has acquired.
Population in the new service areas is expected to grow by 50 percent over the next 10 years, the company said.

"The wastewater business is a natural for us because we can take advantage of the economies of scale that exist due to the overlap of business and operations functions in the drinking water industry and wastewater industries including water purification and quality testing," the company said.
